card.title: Notice the Effort
card.instruction: Make your invisible labor visible through pointed reminders, strategic sighs, and opportunities for appreciation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you put the pizza in, admire the oven. Four hours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's spotless. Can I cook? I'm starving.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Notice the rack as you slide it in. That was an hour.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll buy you dinner if we can keep it clean tonight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. We can toast the other three hours.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 demands notice of four hours cleaning; A3 points to an hour on the rack; A5 asks the offered dinner to recognize the other hours.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 praise and hunger prompt A3 detailed notice; B4 dinner offer prompts A5 a toast to the remaining labor.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants to eat and B4 offers appreciation while avoiding immediately dirtying the work.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 reward to keep the full invisible labor visible, rather than merely accept a meal.

specificity.evidence: A1 oven and four hours make the unrecognized work concrete before A3 itemizes it.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 other three hours follows exactly from A1 four minus A3 rack hour.
